theme_and_archetype.rationale: Anchored by deep midnight blue and navy to fulfill 'koyu gece mavisi ve lacivert tonlarında' constraint, but adopting the Electric & Neon archetype to deliver the 'parlak neon mavi ve beyaz renklerde parlasın' glowing cybersecurity defense vibe. Surfaces must reflect depth (not flat black) to feel like a high-end, modern intelligence dashboard.

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Ensure breathing room for data density.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style grids for blog cards and analysis widgets. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with gap-6 or gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.featured_card: The 'BIOS & MBR Bootkits' card must use col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2 with glowing borders to stand out.
spacing_and_layout.container_styling: Containers use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS with dark layered surfaces, 1px solid border-cyan-500/15, and subtle inner glows (box-shadow).
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Sharp or minimal rounding. rounded-none or rounded-md (max 6px) to maintain the structural, tactical feel.

surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glass variant: bg-[#050B14]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#00F0FF]/20. Sticky top with z-50.
surface_strategies.cards: Retro-Futurism 'Terminal' look mixed with elevated depth. bg-[#0A1128] with hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#00F0FF]/50 transition-all duration-300.
surface_strategies.code_blocks: Deepest dark bg-[#03070C] with explicit 1px border-[#005CFF]/30. Syntax highlighting must use neon cyan, green, and pink colors for Assembly instructions.
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary: bg-transparent border-2 border-[#00F0FF] text-[#00F0FF] hover:bg-[#00F0FF] hover:text-[#050B14] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.2)] transition-all uppercase font-mono text-sm tracking-wider.

components.navigation: Logo left. Nav links center/right (Ana Sayfa, Analizler, Reverse Engineering, Hakkımızda, İletişim). Nav links must have hover effect turning text to #00F0FF with a text-shadow glow.
components.hero_section: Must contain large H1 'ZARARLI YAZILIM VE BOOTKIT ANALİZ LABORATUVARI'. Background should use the cyber_hero_bg with overlay bg-[#050B14]/60 to ensure text legibility.
components.reverse_engineering_section: Dedicated colorful syntax-highlighted Assembly blocks. Use a library like react-syntax-highlighter or raw styled HTML if static. Theme must be dark/neon.
components.admin_dashboard: Clean, dense table layout using Shadcn/UI for lists. Forms for CRUD must use Shadcn Input, Textarea, Select, but styled to match the dark navy theme. Focus rings must be ring-[#00F0FF].
components.rich_text_editor: Admin needs a way to add text, select category, upload images, and inject code blocks. Use a simple WYSIWYG or markdown editor integration.
components.visual_decorators: Include terminal cursor blinking animations (|) on hero subtitles, subtle scanlines over hero images, and neon glows.

cyber_hero_bg.description: Abstract digital network nodes in midnight blue with cyan glows.
cyber_hero_bg.usage: Hero section background overlay with dark gradient.

server_room_dark_blue.description: Server rack in dark blue lighting.
server_room_dark_blue.usage: Featured image for 'BIOS & MBR Bootkits' card or About section.

cybersecurity_abstract_1.usage: Default thumbnail for malware analysis blog posts.

interactions_and_motion.hover: All interactive elements must change color explicitly. Text links hover:text-[#00F0FF], buttons get glowing shadows.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out for cards and buttons.

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive elements (links, buttons, form inputs, nav items) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case denoting their role.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.js files, no TSX) and Tailwind CSS.
Do NOT use Space Grotesk or Inter for headings; stick to Rajdhani or IBM Plex Sans.
Ensure the hero header says exactly 'ZARARLI YAZILIM VE BOOTKIT ANALİZ LABORATUVARI'.
For the 'BIOS & MBR Bootkits' card, make it span larger in the grid and give it an explicit glowing neon border to signify it as featured.
Implement Google OAuth for the admin panel login and a protected route for the dashboard.
Admin dashboard must include CRUD operations with form fields for Title, Category, Content (Rich text), Code Block (Assembly), and Image Upload.
For Reverse Engineering sections, use a syntax highlighter that supports Assembly language with a dark/neon theme.
Embed the media URLs exactly as provided. Do not use generic placeholders.
